title: Dimensions and tolerances for hot-rolled track shoe sections, Part 2: Section TS-H1
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard ( Part 2 ) covers dimensions, dimensional tolerances and mass of hot rolled track shoe section TS-Hl meant for extreme service conditions. ♦Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised ] 3 IS : 10182 ( Part 2 ) - 1985 1.2 The rolling and cutting tolerances are also covered in this standard.

dimensional_tolerances: tolerance on dimensions in Table 1 shall be ± 0*8 mm
marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
